//: EXAMPLE configuration - placeholder values only. Copy this to appsettings.Production.json in
the service directory on the server (INSTALLING.md, step 6) and fill in the real values there.
This file is committed so the SHAPE of the configuration is documented. The real file lives
outside the repository, is owned root:crt-data at mode 0640, and must never be copied back
in - .gitignore blocks appsettings.Production.json for that reason.
Every value under DataTreeRoot, ProductionTreeRoot, PublicDataBaseUrl, ManifestPath, BlobStoreRoot,
FeedbackRoot, FeedbackToAddress, ConnectionString and PublicApiBaseUrl has NO DEFAULT in code. A missing or malformed one
stops the service from starting, with the offending setting named in the journal. That is
deliberate: the failure mode of forgetting is an outage, not a service quietly writing data

CrtServer.//DataTreeRoot: The BETA tree the service may write. On this server: /mydir/http/classic-repair-toolbox.dk/public_html/app-data-BETA/Data
CrtServer.//ProductionTreeRoot: The stable source's folder - REQUIRED, even with publishing to stable off. Named so the BETA settings can be kept away from it. Nothing writes it unless publishing to stable is switched on (the three Production* settings below), and then only by copying files that are already in BETA. On this server: /mydir/http/classic-repair-toolbox.dk/public_html/app-data
CrtServer.//RequiredTreeMarker: Every configured path and the public data URL must contain this. Clear it ONLY when deliberately targeting a tree without it.
CrtServer.//PublicDataBaseUrl: Becomes the url of every entry in BETA's dataChecksums.json. Pairing the BETA tree with the stable URL would give a valid manifest that sends every CRT to the wrong data.
CrtServer.//ManifestPath: Where dataChecksums.json is written. It sits BESIDE the data root, not inside it, so it cannot be derived from DataTreeRoot.
CrtServer.//ProductionDataTreeRoot: Publishing from BETA to the stable source, from the Maintainer tab. OFF while these three are empty. All three or none; none may carry -BETA, and the stable data folder must be writable by the service (INSTALLING.md, step 3). On this server: .../public_html/app-data/Data, .../public_html/app-data/dataChecksums.json and https://classic-repair-toolbox.dk/app-data/Data
CrtServer.//ProductionPublishingAdministratorsOnly: While true, only an administrator may publish a system from BETA to the stable source. A maintainer still sees the system waiting, its plan, and may push it back or reject it - CRT greys the publish out and says why. Set it false to let maintainers publish their own systems. True when left out.
CrtServer.//BlobStoreRoot: Where submitted files are stored, content-addressed by SHA-256. MUST be an absolute path OUTSIDE the web document root - blobs of a submission still under review would otherwise be downloadable by anyone who guessed a hash. Put it beside the service, e.g. <site>/crt-server/blobs. It accumulates contributor-supplied bytes, so watch its size.
CrtServer.//FeedbackRoot: Feedback from CRT's Feedback tab. Each feedback's attached files are saved in a feedback-<random> folder under this, opened from your network share. REQUIRED, absolute, writable by the service (INSTALLING.md, step 3), outside the web document root and away from the data trees and the blob store.
CrtServer.//FeedbackToAddress: Who the feedback mail goes to. REQUIRED.
CrtServer.//FeedbackMaxStoredBytes: The most the saved feedback under FeedbackRoot may take all together. Full, a feedback's text is still mailed but its files are not saved, and the mail says so - delete old feedback folders to make room. 20 GiB when left out; 0 turns the total off.
CrtServer.//ConnectionString: MariaDB. Create a dedicated user; do not reuse another application's credentials.
CrtServer.//PublicApiBaseUrl: Builds the links in verification and password-reset mail. Must be https.
CrtServer.//Smtp: Local postfix. No authentication and no TLS: the connection never leaves the box, and postfix handles outbound delivery. MailFromAddress is REQUIRED - mail sent without a From address is rejected by the receiving server.
CrtServer.//RefreshTokenDays: How long a signed-in session lasts after it was LAST USED. The login's refreshToken IS the bearer token; there is no separate short-lived access token.
CrtServer.//MinimumFreeDiskBytes: Submissions and uploads are refused while the disk holding BlobStoreRoot has less than this free, so nobody can fill the disk the site and database share. 0 turns it off.
CrtServer.//CountLocalNetworkBoardViews: Board views sent from this server's own network (your CRTs at home) are stored like anybody's while this is true, marked fromLocalNetwork = 1 in crt_board_views. Set it to false to stop counting them - the launch check-in's rule. True when left out.
CrtServer.//AllowDataReset: Account > 'Reset contribution data' deletes every submission, every account but the administrators, every maintainer, invitation and system record, the history, the board views and the API usage counts - never the BETA or stable data. It does so ONLY while this is true. Set it true, restart, reset, then set it back to false and restart again (INSTALLING.md, 'Resetting the contribution data'). False when left out.
CrtServer.//Argon2: RFC 9106's second recommended profile, sized for a small box. May be RAISED without invalidating existing passwords - the encoded hash carries the parameters it was made with. The validator refuses to start below a floor, so these cannot be quietly weakened.
